repair_results_text: Balancing property locations raises appearance-probe paired correctness from 0.00% to 85.33%; individual repaired seeds score 87.75%, 81.75%, 86.50%. The conditional 95% scene interval is [81.25, 89.08] percentage points. Balanced regret falls from 0.016907 to 0.001480; the paired reduction is 0.015427 with interval [0.014748, 0.016115].

repair_composition_text: The repair does not improve every metric: original-layout appearance mIoU falls from 0.9454 to 0.8327, and balanced scene-macro false-safe increases from 2.31% to 2.98%. Thus the paired-decision repair cannot be interpreted as a uniform safety improvement. After repair, the appearance-probe learned-minus-analytic regret contrast is 0.0000000 with interval [0.0000000, 0.0000000]. This comparison is secondary and adaptive. For the joint-family probe restricted to card D, repaired analytic regret is 0.000539; the D-only estimate is saved separately from the all-card paired diagnostic, whose changed optima concern cards A and D.

conclusion_text: The spatial-field interface makes capability- and rule-conditioned risk inspectable, but ordinary appearance-shift scores do not establish correct property grounding. Our matched intervention changes a near-zero paired success rate to 85.33% after a controlled location-balancing repair. The public composition equation supplies a necessary zero-parameter control and a transparent error decomposition. The strongest supported result is currently the measured failure and repair of the visual component. General semantic-safe control, the necessity of a CF loss, and successful VLM spatial distillation remain unestablished.
